scripts.build: TURBO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 TURBO_DAEMON=false TURBO_NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1 turbo run build --output-logs=errors-only
scripts.build:tools: TURBO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 TURBO_DAEMON=false TURBO_NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1 turbo run build --filter=@omne-harness/repo-toolchain --output-logs=errors-only
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:members
scripts.test:members: pnpm run --silent build:tools && ./scripts/with-test-slot.sh node --experimental-strip-types tools/test-runner/src/testing/cli.ts run --all
scripts.test:gate: pnpm run --silent build:tools && ./scripts/with-test-slot.sh node --experimental-strip-types tools/test-runner/src/testing/cli.ts step test
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test:format && pnpm run build && pnpm run check:declarations && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:gate && pnpm run lint:rules && pnpm run lint:oxlint && pnpm run lint:deps
scripts.lint:report: oxlint -c .oxlintrc.json -W correctness --vitest-plugin tools scripts packages apps && knip --no-exit-code
